## Reader need

What can a developer understand or complete after this change? Identify the page's purpose and keep it applicable across customers.

## Source and release

Link the authoritative schema, SDK release or related product PR. State any deployment requirement or experimental limitation.

## Validation

Record the checks actually performed: preview, Mintlify build and links, changed examples, external URLs and downloads. List any unverified behavior.

## Publication check

Identify changed live pages, redirects or downloads to verify after deployment. Check that examples use neutral data and that no private customer implementation details are included.
